when_to_use: Use it for predictions and promises: 'Lloverá mañana.' / 'Te llamaré.'
It can also mean 'I wonder / probably': '¿Dónde estará Ana?'
Near plans often stay in the present: 'Mañana viajamos.' Save this tense for will-type future.

examples.es: El año que viene viviré en Valencia.
examples.en: Next year I will live in Valencia.
examples.note: A future situation, not a booked near plan.

examples.en: I will write to you when I arrive.

common_mistake: Don't force this tense onto every future idea. 'Tomorrow I'm going' is often present or ir a + infinitive: 'Mañana voy' / 'Mañana voy a ir'.
